description: This file implements an Android activity named NinePatchLab that demonstrates and manipulates Android NinePatch drawables. It includes UI components, background generation, FPS measurement, and user interaction for changing drawable properties and backgrounds.

classes.name: NinePatchLab
classes.description: Main activity class for demoing NinePatch drawables, handling user input and rendering.

classes.name: NPView
classes.description: Custom View class for rendering background and buttons, measuring FPS, and handling drawing.

methods.name: updateTitle
methods.description: Updates the activity title bar with the current status, including dither, filter, and FPS info.

methods.name: make_custom_bg
methods.description: Creates a custom gradient drawable background with specific colors.

methods.name: make_solid_bg
methods.description: Creates a solid color drawable background.

methods.name: setDrawableFlags
methods.description: Sets dither and filter flags on a drawable object based on current settings.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw to render the background, buttons, and FPS data.

methods.name: toggleFPS
methods.description: Toggles the display of FPS counter and resets counters.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events to toggle dither/filter, change background, and toggle FPS display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the main view.
